child_briefs.title: StageWorker Base Infrastructure
child_briefs.scope: Build ngv2/workers/base.py exposing StageWorker which, given (task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn), fetches the task via get_task_fn, runs stage_fn over the resulting context, and writes the structured artifact dict(s) returned by stage_fn to the task's output_path via write_fn. Write a paired test_authoring sibling test file whose mutation_target is ngv2/workers/base.py to verify it with at least two edge cases.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not build the seam assembler (build_default_seams), the conductor loop, or gated_advance. Do not implement get_task here. Do not write any phase worker module (hunt.py, triage.py, verify.py, poc.py, detonate.py, novelty.py, report.py).
child_briefs.inputs: Consumes get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package} from conductor_glue (ngv2/session_get_task.py) as the injected get_task_fn. Consumes `run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict]` as the injected stage_fn.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/workers/base.py which exposes `StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn)` that fetches via get_task_fn, runs stage_fn over the context, and writes artifact dict(s) to the task output_path via write_fn. Paired test_authoring sibling test file for base.py with mutation_target set to base.py and a verification_command naming the authored oracle.

child_briefs.title: Early-Phase Workers: Hunt, Triage, and Verify
child_briefs.scope: Build three phase workers: ngv2/workers/hunt.py, triage.py, and verify.py, each exposing run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict] that composes the injected llm-client seam with the relevant existing ngv2 module/gates for that phase. Each module is a single file with a paired test_authoring sibling whose mutation_target is that module to verify it with at least two edge cases driven by stub llm-client and stub seams.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not build the seam assembler (build_default_seams), the conductor loop, or gated_advance. Do not edit any existing committed module in place. Do not write the StageWorker base runner or the late-phase workers (poc.py, detonate.py, novelty.py, report.py).
child_briefs.inputs: Consumes get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package} from conductor_glue (ngv2/session_get_task.py). Consumes `StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn)` from base_worker. Reads (does not modify) the signatures of existing seams it composes via injection: ngv2/llm_client.py (the injected model seam); the four may_confirm gate modules; ngv2/contracts.py dataclasses Finding, PoC, LiveTestReport; ngv2/artifact_harvester.py parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) for the artifact dict shape.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/workers/hunt.py, triage.py, verify.py — each exposing `run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict]` of artifact dicts parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact and shaped for the contracts dataclasses. Each file has a test_authoring sibling with mutation_target set to that file and a verification_command naming the authored oracle.

child_briefs.title: Exploitation phase workers: poc, detonate
child_briefs.scope: Build the two exploitation phase workers as whole-file modules, each exposing run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict]: ngv2/workers/poc.py (composes the injected llm-client seam with the injected poc_writer and poc_repair_loop seams to produce a PoC) and ngv2/workers/detonate.py (composes the injected detonation seam to execute the PoC and capture results). poc.py returns artifact dicts from which contracts.PoC can be built; detonate.py returns artifact dicts from which contracts.LiveTestReport can be built. All writer/repair/detonation behavior arrives via the injected seams dict so each module is deterministic and oracle-testable with no real model/network/subprocess. Each module is a single file with a paired test_authoring sibling whose mutation_target is that module and whose verification_command names the authored RED oracle, with at least two edge cases per leaf driven by stub seams (e.g. stub llm-client/poc_writer returning empty/malformed output; the poc_repair_loop or detonation seam reporting failure).
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not build StageWorker, the seam assembler (build_default_seams), the conductor loop, or gated_advance. Do not implement get_task. Do not edit ngv2/poc_writer.py, ngv2/poc_repair_loop.py, or ngv2/detonation.py in place — compose them only as injected seams. Do not run any real subprocess/detonation, LLM call, or network inside any oracle; do not auto-submit to huntr or contact any external service. Do not implement hunt/triage/verify/novelty/report logic (other children).
child_briefs.inputs: Each module exposes run_stage(context: dict, seams: dict) -> list[dict]. context originates from get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package} (prior_findings supplies the finding to exploit). seams carries the injected llm-client seam (ngv2/llm_client.py, read-only) and the injected poc_writer/poc_repair_loop seams for poc.py and the injected detonation seam for detonate.py (read-only). Reads (does not modify) ngv2/contracts.py dataclasses PoC and LiveTestReport for output field names, ngv2/artifact_harvester.py parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) for the artifact dict shape, and ngv2/session_db.py insert_poc/insert_report for the persist-side shape.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/workers/poc.py and ngv2/workers/detonate.py — each exposing run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict] of artifact dicts parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase); poc.py dicts build contracts.PoC, detonate.py dicts build contracts.LiveTestReport. Freezes the phase contract: run_stage(context: dict, seams: dict) -> list[dict]. Each file has a test_authoring sibling with mutation_target set to that file and a verification_command naming the authored oracle, covering at least two edge cases (stub writer empty/malformed output; a repair-loop or detonation seam reporting failure).
child_briefs.interfaces: run_stage(context: dict, seams: dict) -> list[dict]; consumes get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package}; artifact dicts parseable by parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) and buildable into contracts.PoC / contracts.LiveTestReport

Each returns artifact dicts shaped so artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact can parse them and so contracts.Finding can be built from them. All model/gate behavior arrives via the injected seams dict so each module is deterministic and oracle-testable with no real model/network/subprocess. Each of the three modules is a single file with a paired test_authoring sibling whose mutation_target is that module and whose verification_command names the authored RED oracle, with at least two edge cases per leaf driven by a stub llm-client / stub gate seams (e.g. stub llm-client returning empty/malformed output; a may_confirm gate seam reporting failure/denial).
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not build StageWorker, the seam assembler (build_default_seams), the conductor loop, or gated_advance. Do not implement get_task. Do not edit ngv2/llm_client.py or the four may_confirm gate modules in place — compose them only as injected seams. Do not weaken, bypass, or auto-pass any acceptance/may_confirm gate; do not auto-submit to huntr or contact any external service. No real LLM call, network, or subprocess may run inside any oracle. Do not implement poc/detonate/novelty/report logic (other children).
child_briefs.inputs: Each module exposes run_stage(context: dict, seams: dict) -> list[dict]. context originates from get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package}. seams carries the injected llm-client seam (matching ngv2/llm_client.py, read-only) and, for verify, the four injected may_confirm gate seams (matching the may_confirm gate modules, read-only). Reads (does not modify) ngv2/contracts.py dataclass Finding for output field names, ngv2/artifact_harvester.py parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) for the artifact dict shape, and ngv2/session_db.py insert_finding for the persist-side shape.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/workers/hunt.py, ngv2/workers/triage.py, ngv2/workers/verify.py — each exposing run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict] of Finding-shaped artifact dicts parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) and from which contracts.Finding can be built. Freezes the phase contract: run_stage(context: dict, seams: dict) -> list[dict]. Each file has a test_authoring sibling with mutation_target set to that file and a verification_command naming the authored oracle, covering at least two edge cases (stub llm-client empty/malformed output; a may_confirm gate seam reporting failure).
child_briefs.interfaces: run_stage(context: dict, seams: dict) -> list[dict]; consumes get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package}; artifact dicts parseable by parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) and buildable into contracts.Finding

child_briefs.title: StageWorker orchestration shell over injected seams
child_briefs.scope: Build the NEW ngv2/workers/ package foundation: ngv2/workers/__init__.py and ngv2/workers/base.py exposing StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn). StageWorker is a generic, phase-agnostic shell that (1) fetches the task context by calling the injected get_task_fn(task) (which matches the conductor_glue get_task signature), (2) runs the injected stage_fn over the resulting context to obtain a list of structured artifact dicts, and (3) writes each returned artifact dict to the task's output_path by calling the injected write_fn. All side effects (model, db, filesystem) arrive through injected seams so the module is deterministic and oracle-testable with no real model/network/subprocess/filesystem. base.py has a paired test_authoring sibling (e.g. ngv2/workers/test_base.py) whose mutation_target is base.py and whose verification_command names the authored RED oracle, with at least two edge cases driven by a stub get_task_fn / stub stage_fn / stub write_fn (e.g. stage_fn returns an empty list so nothing is written; get_task_fn returns a context missing expected keys / a malformed/empty artifact dict from stage_fn).
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement any phase logic (no hunt/triage/verify/poc/detonate/novelty/report behavior) — those live in the phase-worker children and are supplied to StageWorker only as the injected stage_fn. Do not build the seam assembler (build_default_seams), the conductor loop, or gated_advance. Do not implement get_task — it is consumed only as the injected get_task_fn. Do not perform any real filesystem I/O (write_fn is injected), real LLM call, network, or subprocess inside the oracle. Do not edit any existing committed module in place.
child_briefs.inputs: Consumes get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package} from conductor_glue (ngv2/session_get_task.py) as the injected get_task_fn that StageWorker calls. Consumes an injected stage_fn(context: dict) -> list[dict] (the bound phase run_stage; supplied as a stub in the oracle). Consumes an injected write_fn(output_path, artifact: dict) for persistence (stub in oracle). Reads (does not modify) the task object which carries an output_path. Reads (read-only) ngv2/artifact_harvester.py parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) for the artifact dict shape and ngv2/contracts.py dataclasses Finding, PoC, LiveTestReport for the artifact field names that flow through unchanged.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/workers/__init__.py and ngv2/workers/base.py exposing StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn) that calls get_task_fn(task) -> context, runs stage_fn(context) -> list[dict], and writes each artifact dict to the task output_path via write_fn(output_path, artifact). Freezes the shell contract: StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn) where stage_fn(context: dict) -> list[dict] and get_task_fn matches get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package}. Plus a test_authoring sibling with mutation_target set to ngv2/workers/base.py and a verification_command naming the authored oracle, covering at least two edge cases (empty list from stage_fn; malformed/empty context or artifact dict).
child_briefs.interfaces: StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn); stage_fn(context: dict) -> list[dict]; get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package}; write_fn(output_path, artifact: dict)
